description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'I18NDao' responsible for retrieving internationalization language data and translation messages from a database within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching language details by code and for retrieving all translation messages associated with a language code.

classes.name: I18NDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for managing internationalization language and translation data, extending the BaseDao class for database interactions.

methods.name: getLanguageByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves an enabled language entity based on the provided language code.

methods.name: getAllTranslationMessagesByLangCode
methods.description: Fetches all translation messages for the specified language code, including associated group/module names.

methods.name: createQueryBuilderWrapperForAllTranslationByLangCode
methods.description: Constructs a QueryBuilderWrapper instance configured to retrieve all translation messages for a specific language code, validating the language code beforehand.
